title: Refine the verification-credit wording: lapsed-but-not-retaken claims, retained store-repair runs, and record eligibility in docs
outcome: The claim-refusal cause, the launcher's credit line for retained runs, and the docs' promise about records each match what actually happens.
acceptance: The claim-refusal detail (engram_verification_record_refusal_detail) also covers a claim that expired without being retaken and a pending handoff, for example 'the original claim was no longer valid for this record', without forwarding Engram's message or reason.

A retained run whose registration failed because the store stayed in repair, created by a launcher that did not yet record registration.storeTransient, gets no generic credit line, recognised by the launcher's own store-repair refusal text. Shown by a behavioural test.
docs/test.md limits the 'gets its record without a rerun' promise to an eligible frozen record whose only obstacle was delivery (an unclassified stage, for example, gets no record).
